name: symphony
description: Inspect and administer a configured Symphony installation through its qxctl contracts.
long_description: Local C++ MCP bridge for an independently installed Symphony qxctl. A required private connection profile pins the selected executable and registry. Profiles default to read operations; specific non-read commands require explicit configuration and native authorization. Bundled launchers select included macOS or Linux x86-64/ARM64 executables. Linux requires Ubuntu 22.04 or newer with OpenSSL 3 and libstdc++ runtime libraries; macOS executables are unsigned. See docs/mcp-registry.md for setup and qualification limits. The 0.2.0 public interface exposes the same versioned operation catalogue as the OpenAI package: 653 operation tools plus connection status.

connection_profile.title: Symphony connection profile
connection_profile.description: Select an existing private connection.json created by scripts/configure_connection.py. It must pin your selected qxctl installation, be owned by your user, and have mode 0600 or stricter. Setup requires Python 3.11+; launching the configured bridge does not.
